P1.strategy: Cooperate with untested opponents when expected good-player welfare favors mutual cooperation; update beliefs from observed behavior and defect when an opponent is strongly likely selfish.

P2.strategy: Cooperate with likely-good opponents to maximize good players’ combined payoff; defect against likely-selfish opponents. Treat observed cooperation as evidence of a good role, while updating cautiously.

P3.strategy: Cooperate with likely-good opponents to maximize good players’ combined payoff; defect only when an opponent is strongly inferred selfish.

P4.strategy: Cooperate when it raises expected combined payoff for good players; update beliefs from observed actions.

P5.strategy: Cooperate with P10: the posterior chance they are selfish is below the threshold where defection helps overall good-player payoffs. C also best supports good-player welfare if P10 is good.

P6.strategy: Cooperate with likely-good opponents to improve good-player welfare; prior cooperation strongly suggests P3, P5, and P7 are good.

Cooperate with untested P2: their selfish probability is below the threshold where defecting’s gain against a selfish player outweighs the welfare lost against a good player. Update from their observed action; cooperate with good players and defect when evidence strongly indicates selfishness.
